title: Dynamic Factor Analysis of Price Movements in the Philippine Stock Exchange
hypothesis: One-factor DFM extracts systematic/market factor similar to PSEi (F_t ~ PSEi); two-factor DFM decomposes into market trend (F1t) and volatility (F2t) offering new portfolio risk perspective beyond CAPM; common factors serve as viable real-time market indicators reducing GDP nowcasting RMSE by over 34% out-of-sample.
data_sources: fastquant Python wrapper for Phisix API (PSE stock prices)
Philippine quarterly GDP growth rates - not stated source file but described in nowcasting section
sample: Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) stock closing prices via Phisix API via fastquant Python library plus PSEi composite index from stooq.com. Return definition percentage return R_it=(S_it - S_{i(t-1)})/S_{i(t-1)} where S_it is closing price. Sample period 2015-01-01 to 2020-12-31 for DFM fitting including COVID pandemic period as robustness test. Filter: drop any stock with >1% missing observations over period. Retained sample counts: count_S_stocks_retained=72 stocks (listed by ticker in Tables res135/res225: 2GO,ABA,AC,AEV,AGI,ALI,AP,BDO,BEL,BLOOM,BPI,BRN,CEB,CHIB,CNPF,COSCO,CPG,DD,DMC,DNL,EEI,EW,FGEN,FLI,FNI,FPH,GERI,GLO,GMA7,GTCAP,HOUSE,ICT,IMI,JFC,JGS,LC,LPZ,LTG,MAXS,MBT,MEG,MER,MPI,MWC,MWIDE,NI,NIKL,PCOR,PGOLD,PLC,PNB,PNX,PX,PXP,RLC,RRHI,SCC,SECB,SLI,SM,SMC,SMPH,SSI,SSP,STI,TECH,TEL,UBP,URC,VITA,VLL,WEB). Excluded stocks not listed but implied = low-volume stocks generally. For nowcasting application: in-sample training period 2015-01-01 to 2020-12-31 same stocks; out-of-sample evaluation period 2021-01-01 to 2022-12-31; target is Philippine quarterly GDP growth rates; monthly indicators derived from F_t to explain quarterly GDP.
method: 1. Data collection: download daily closing prices S_it for all PSE stocks via fastquant/Phisix API 2015-01-01 to 2022-12-31 and daily PSEi closes from https://stooq.com/q/d/?s=%5Epsei; also obtain Philippine quarterly GDP growth rates.
2. Data cleaning: for period 2015-01-01 to 2020-12-31 compute per-stock missingrate; drop any stock with missingrate> param_missing_threshold=1%; resulting N= count_S_stocks_retained=72.
3. Transform to stationary returns: compute percentage return R_it=(S_it - S_{i(t-1)})/S_{i(t-1)} for retained stocks; similarly compute PSEi return series; no winzorization stated.

4. Factor number selection: for n=0,...,maxN estimate n factors via PCA, compute mean squared residuals V(n), compute IC1(n), IC2(n), IC3(n) per Bai 2002: IC1=lnV(n)+n*((N+T)/NT)*ln(NT/(N+T)), IC2=lnV(n)+n*((N+T)/NT)*ln min(N,T), IC3=lnV(n)+n*(ln min(N,T)/min(N,T)). Plot IC vs n; IC lower for n=1 or 2 vs n=0 white-noise; choose n=1 as best IC but also retain n=2 as viable comparably close.
5. Lag order selection: for each n choose p for F_t VAR(p) and q for idiosyncratic AR(q) by Bayesian Information Criterion BIC; resulting selected specs: (n=1,p=3,q=5) and (n=2,p=2,q=5).

6. State-space formulation of DFM: R_t = M X_t + eps_t (Sigma_eps=0), X_t = T X_{t-1}+ eta_t where X_t stacks [F_t,...,F_{t-p+1},tildeZ_t,...,tildeZ_{t-q+1}], beta is SxN loadings, sigma diag loadings, Psi_j diag AR coeffs, Sigma_eta=diag(I_n,0,...,0,sigma^2,0,...,0).

7. Estimation: for fixed parameters M,T,Sigma_eta run Kalman filter prediction mu_{t|t-1}=T mu_{t-1|t-1}, Sigma_{t|t-1}=T Sigma_{t-1|t-1} T'+Sigma_eta with update K_t=Sigma_{t|t-1} M'(M Sigma_{t|t-1} M'+Sigma_eps)^{-1}, mu_{t|t}=mu_{t|t-1}+K_t(Y_t-M mu_{t|t-1}), Sigma_{t|t}=Sigma_{t|t-1}-K_t M Sigma_{t|t-1}. Maximize likelihood over M,T,Sigma_eta via MLE. Then Kalman smoother at t'>t: J_t=Sigma_{t|t} T' Sigma_{t+1|t}^{-1}, mu_{t|t'}=mu_{t|t}+J_t(mu_{t+1|t'}-mu_{t+1|t}), Sigma_{t|t'}=Sigma_{t|t}+J_t(Sigma_{t+1|t'}-Sigma_{t+1|t})J_t'. Extract smoothed common factors F_t and loadings beta_i, sigma_i.

8. PCA comparison: compute sample covariance Sigma_hat of X (TxS return matrix), eigen-decompose Sigma_hat a = lambda a, order eigenvalues descending, PCi = X a_(i) with unit eigenvectors orthogonal. Correlate PCs with F_t and PSEi returns.

9. CAPM validation: obtain CAPM beta_i per stock from Barrons market-data for same period; scatter plot vs DFM beta_i/beta1i/beta2i; compute Pearson correlations estimate_corr_CAPM_beta_beta_i_one_factor=0.8348 etc; test significance of loadings and VAR coeffs at alpha=param_alpha_significance=0.05 (flag ns = not significant). LC flagged ns due to stock-specific closure order 2017-2020.

10. Two-factor interpretation: verify correlation F1t-F2t=0.0798 ~ orthogonal; regress one-factor Ft on F1t,F2t to get R2=0.998 indicating decomposition; label F1t market trend, F2t market volatility.

11. Nowcasting GDP application: take DFM(n=2,p=2,q=5) smoothed F_t for in-sample 2015-2020 and filtered F_t for out-of-sample 2021-2022 to avoid leakage; convert daily F1t,F2t to monthly indicators per calendar month: mean(F1t), sd(F1t), mean(F2t), sd(F2t) - paper says mean and standard deviation of F1t and F2t are calculated per month (implies 4 indicators per month, 12 per quarter). Merge by quarter (Jan-Mar -> Q1 etc). Fit benchmark AR(1) for quarterly GDP growth via OLS on in-sample; fit augmented AR(1) w/ F_t via OLS adding monthly indicators as regressors to explain quarterly GDP growth. Forecast in-sample and out-of-sample; compute RMSE per Table rmse; compute improvements 84.11% in-sample and 34.47% out-of-sample.
